newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct motorcycle production up 2.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct motorcycle production up 2.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production in October rose 2.2 percent from a year earlier to 209,808 motorcycles, up for the fourth straight month on a year-on-year basis, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said on Monday.

Domestic motorcycle sales fell 11.7 percent from a year earlier to 64,874 in October.
The association expects Japan's motorcycle exports in October to have shown a gain of about eight percent from a year earlier. The industry body will announce its official export figures on Thursday.
Japan's motorcycle production in January to October fell 5.2 percent from a year earlier to 2.21 million units.
